Who We Help  /  Individuals

Help for you, not for your computer.

Things people ask us about

“It's gotten so slow.”

Cleanups, updates, backups, and honest advice about whether a machine is worth keeping.

“Is this email a scam?”

Passwords, two-factor setup, and a plain checklist for spotting the fakes yourself.

“The wifi drops in the back room.”

Home internet, routers, printers, and TVs that finally talk to each other.

“Where did my photos go?”

Recovering files, organizing what's left, and setting up backup so it can't happen twice.

How a visit goes

Usually an hour or two. You keep the notes.

  1. 01 We talk first. A short call to hear what's going on. Free, and no pressure to book anything.
  2. 02 We sit down together. In person around Greater Portland, or remotely if that's easier for you.
  3. 03 You leave with it written down. What we changed, what to watch for, and what you can safely ignore.

Wondering what it costs?

Rates are sliding-scale and quoted when we talk — never a surprise on an invoice. Our engagement models are laid out on How We Work.
